rubric.reason: every assertion is on the module's documented return value — the exact key set and values of the returned patch. No test references an internal helper, a private field, or a call count. The module is pure, so its return value IS its observable.

assertions use toEqual against a complete expected object rather than spot-checking one property, so an extra key the implementation should not emit fails the test. The date cases additionally assert the OTHER date key is absent via not.toHaveProperty, which is the property that actually matters and which a presence-only assertion would miss.
zero mocks — the module under test is pure and is called directly. The two local helpers build plain fixture objects, not test doubles.

AC-8's decidable half is covered by 25 cases; its DOM half is explicitly recorded as MANUAL with a six-step script, rather than silently omitted. AC-7 is mapped to the four existing suites. The eight out-of-phase ACs are each attributed to the phase that delivered them.

the clearing and omitting cases for description and priority are deliberate pairs asserting opposite outcomes over the same field, which is the discriminative contrast PRD AC-2 requires rather than duplication. The two mode-switch cases differ in direction and each asserts a different key's absence.

the suite fails at module resolution — src/shared/task-edit.ts does not exist. For a brand-new pure module that is the only red available, and the manifest says so plainly instead of implying a behavioural red it cannot have (unlike phase 3, there is no prior implementation to fail against). The manifest then does the harder and more useful thing: it names which assertions discriminate against which naive implementation — a blanket `?? null` fails the omit-when-already-empty cases, and an emit-everything builder fails the editable-set ceiling case. That is a stronger legitimacy argument than a failure count.
lifecycle ledger is empty — no existing test was updated or removed.

notes: This is the phase where the tdd: true declaration could most easily have been satisfied vacuously, by declaring AC-8 purely visual and producing no test file at all — a path docs/context/methodology.md explicitly permits. The writer instead applied that document's actual obligation (extract the decidable part, test it first, exempt only the glue) and produced a suite covering the unit's subtlest rule. Recorded because the easier path was available and legitimate, and was not taken.
